HOW WE VERIFY

Trust is built in layers.

CommuneWorld is designed to show the difference between a self-declared profile and information that has been checked.

01

Confirm identity

Aadhaar, PAN and date-of-birth checks establish that a real person is behind the profile.

02

Match the person

Face and liveness checks help reduce impersonation, copied photographs and duplicate identities.

03

Verify the claim

Profession or status can be checked through relevant proof—for example an official ID, GST proof, contract or student ID.

04

Show clear signals

The profile shows what has been checked, while optional information such as income remains consent-led.

✓

VERIFICATION SIGNALS

Know what has been checked.

✓ Identity✓ Face & liveness✓ Profession / statusOptional✓ Income, if chosen

Verification improves trust and accountability; it does not replace personal judgment, consent or platform safety controls.

WHY VERIFICATION MATTERS NOW

The internet made meeting easier. It did not make knowing easier.

Profiles can be copied, credentials can be self-declared and intent can be unclear. Verification cannot remove every risk—but it can replace some uncertainty with visible, accountable signals.

01

Fewer fake identities

Verification makes it harder to create disposable profiles or pretend to be someone else.

02

Claims with context

Users can understand whether identity, profession, status or optional information has actually been checked.

03

Better first decisions

Trust signals, intent and shared context help people decide who to talk to, meet, hire or learn from.

04

More accountability

A persistent verified identity supports better behaviour, meaningful reputation and stronger safety operations.

i

Verification with respect. CommuneWorld’s trust model is designed around clear consent, purpose-limited checks, privacy controls, reporting and grievance redressal—not unnecessary public exposure.

ABOUT COMMUNEWORLD

A place where identity, intention and opportunity come together.

CommuneWorld is an India-first verified connection network created for the many ways people actually relate: social, professional, community, expertise, events, travel, friendship, dating and marriage.

It is not built to label a person by one intention forever. It gives every member one trusted profile and the freedom to decide why, when and how they want to connect.

Operated byKamna Creations Private Limited

CLEAR ANSWERS

What CommuneWorld is—and what it is not.

Is CommuneWorld a dating app?+

No. CommuneWorld is a wider verified connection network. Dating or marriage can be selected intentions, alongside friendship, business, events, travel, community, mentorship and expert guidance.

What does a verification badge mean?+

It should identify the specific layer that has been checked—such as identity, face/liveness or profession/status—rather than making a vague promise that every claim is verified.

Can my reason for connecting change?+

Yes. Your verified identity stays consistent while your intentions, interests, availability and goals can evolve.

How can people create value and earn?+

Members can offer expert sessions, host paid events, grow communities, participate in referrals and use wallet-supported earning opportunities designed into the platform.
